title: Android Client Architecture Deepening
problem: The Android client has a solid foundation, but Public Client runtime orchestration, browse side effects, player lifecycle, UI component ownership, Home read models, and persistence/build hygiene need fearless deepening before the next product wave expands them.

evidence.summary: Opened the fearless Android architecture-deepening lane and split the review findings into vertical tasks. No production code changed.

Introduced PublicClientRuntime above PublicClientApiExecutor, migrated connection, browse, playback, and User Playback State clients to it, deleted obsolete executor helpers, and passed focused plus full Android JVM tests on 2026-05-22.

Introduced BrowseSessionEffectCoordinator and BrowseSessionLoadIntent, moved saveable-state and route-displayed effect ownership out of BrowseShellHost, preserved transient player-route detail state, and passed focused plus full Android JVM tests on 2026-05-22.

Introduced PlaybackSessionRuntime and PlaybackSessionRuntimeFactory, promoted PlayerRouteHost to the Android-owned runtime seam, moved Media3/token/exit runtime construction out of PlaybackPlayerRoute, and passed focused plus full Android JVM tests on 2026-05-22.

Removed browse-package pass-through wrappers for generic design-system primitives, switched callers to direct ui.components imports, extracted Source Picker and Detail presentation builders into test-covered files, and passed focused UI plus full Android JVM tests on 2026-05-22.

Introduced HomeReadModel and section-level HomeSectionState/Managed Artwork states, updated Home data loading and rendering for partial/degraded sections, added ClientBrowseDataSource partial-success/degraded-section tests, and passed focused browse plus full Android JVM tests on 2026-05-22.

Adopted lifecycle-runtime-compose and collectAsStateWithLifecycle for app, browse, connection, and player state collection, recorded persistence/build follow-on decisions, and passed focused lifecycle tests plus Validate-AndroidLocal.ps1 -SkipSmoke on 2026-05-22.

continue_policy.notes: ACAD-090 closeout is complete. Split large product scopes such as downloads/offline, Android TV, PiP/Cast full implementation, DataStore/Room migration, Gradle module split, token-vault replacement, CI/device-farm policy, or SDK publishing into separate workstreams when prioritized.
